findings.reason: Its clauses 2–4 use L_x where the third-slot derivative L_w/L_v is required, while the proof differentiates L_w; it therefore does not establish the transport identity consumed by pthm-cm07-coordinate-covariance-of-the-equations (F1, proof steps 1.1 and 2.1).

Clause (d) says each constrained configuration is represented exactly once but assumes only a surjective immersion; the approved periodic map X:R→circle has infinitely many preimages, so resolve the definition while preserving the pendulum claim.

Clarifying clause (d) to admit the approved covering parametrization triggers the 64-item direct/indirect dependency closure; owner review is required for outside-batch consumers listed in consumer_checks.
The Statement reuses G for the constraint map and kinetic metric, and N for particle count and constraint locus; assign distinct typed symbols so D_xG and the metric are unambiguous.

The gauge is only C² near [a,b] but L′ is claimed C² on all I₀×Q×R³ᴺ; C² gauge data yield only C¹ added terms, and its action dimension is unstated, so localize L′ and specify an action-valued C³ gauge or prove weaker sufficient regularity.
In the SI force branch x,y,z have length and t has time, so z′=xy′ is dimensionally inconsistent and 1+t² is undefined; supply reference length/time scales and rescale the curve and data.
State [m]=μ, [k]=μτ⁻², [ω]=τ⁻¹, [T]=τ and the length dimension of εηₙ; define the C² supremum norm used to establish both signs arbitrarily near the stationary curve.
X(r,θ,z) is periodic in θ and misses the z-axis, so it is a local diffeomorphism onto R³ minus that axis, not a global chart of Q=R³; state that scope and the dimensions of r, θ and z.

For k=2 the reaction multiplier is (λ₁,λ₂), here λ₂=0, not a scalar times ∇G; distinguish the constraint map from the kinetic metric, type F(t,q,v), define J as an admissible interval and state dimensions.
